result.title: Sub-Riemannian structure for Oriented Point Clouds
result.summary: Many frameworks dealing with 3D (oriented) point clouds define locality in the ambient Euclidean space: $k$-nearest-neighbor graphs and radius balls in $\mathbb{R}^3$ are critical to define which points are "close to one another" and should exchange information. This can unintentionally merge sampled surfaces that are close in space but geometrically distinct such as the two faces of a thin leaf. Then, features are more prone to leak across boundaries which hinder performance. To address this, we propose to define a sub-Riemannian contact metric on position-orientation space $\mathbb{M}=\mathbb{R}^3\times \mathbb{S}^2$: points are lifted to $(x,n)$ with $n$ a surface normal, and "motion" is constrained to a non-holonomic horizontal distribution in which spatial velocity must stay in the plane orthogonal to the normal which can reorient at a cost. From this, we derive an explicit score, which locally approximate the distance, to compare oriented points for downstream tasks. We report improved segmentation and correspondence accuracy near contact when using the score as a drop-in change inside PointNet++ aggregation mechanism as well as reduced leakage when using it to simulate heat diffusion on oriented points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文主张在位置-朝向空间 R³×S² 上引入 sub-Riemannian contact 度量，使「邻近」受法向约束的水平分布限制，并导出一个局部近似距离的显式 score，作为 PointNet++ 聚合中的替换项用于分割与对应，同时用于模拟有向点上的热扩散。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心线索是「空间接近但几何上不同不应交换信息」，这与 LVR 中 latent 相似度需区分内容、位置与几何结构、以及视觉细节保留和跨边界信息泄漏的问题可能相关，可供核查邻域或度量定义是否影响内部状态的几何保真。
